findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The class was changed from `DetectorHandler` (where it implemented the only abstract method, `evaluate`) to `StatefulDetectorHandler`, but it does not implement any of the new abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Because it still inherits `abc.ABC` through the base, `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` remains abstract. `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates it via `group_type.detector_handler(self)` (src/sentry/workflow_engine/models/detector.py:86), so for any Detector whose type is `metric_alert_fire`, that property now raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class` instead of returning a handler that yields an empty evaluation as it did before. Stub implementations or a concrete handler are needed.

findings.title: Expected occurrence in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe uses the wrong group key
findings.body: The expected occurrence is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, PriorityLevel.HIGH)`, but the value actually evaluated is `expected_result.group_key`, which is `"group_key"`. `build_fingerprint` embeds the group key, so the expected `IssueOccurrence` has fingerprint `[<detector_id>:val1]` while the handler produces `[<detector_id>:group_key]`. Since `DetectorEvaluationResult` (and presumably `IssueOccurrence`) is compared field-by-field, the first assertion compares unequal and the test fails; even if equality ignored the fingerprint, the test would not be validating the occurrence it claims to. Build the expected occurrence with `"group_key"`.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still documents a list return value
findings.body: The return type of `evaluate` was changed to `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`, but the docstring still says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". Anyone implementing or calling the (now changed) handler contract will be misled about the return shape, which is exactly the part of the API this PR is changing.

findings.title: Occurrence helper ignores `value`, so the new hook's value argument is never verified
findings.body: `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` accepts `value` but never uses it, and several call sites pass an unrelated value (`test_results_on_change` evaluates 100 but builds the expected occurrence with 6; `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe` evaluates 10 but builds with 6; `test_state_results_multi_group` evaluates 10 for group_2 but builds with 6). As a result no test verifies that `evaluate_group_key_value` forwards the evaluated group value to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`, even though that value is a required input of the newly added hook. Include `value` in the generated occurrence/event data and use matching values in the expectations.
